proposal_title: Formal Addition of GenerationJob.attempt_index and 90-Minute Safety Lease TTL
domain_specific_rationale: Formally ratifying `attempt_index` (integer >= 1) and explicit lease semantics with a 90-minute safety Lease TTL and 30-second worker heartbeats resolves critical distributed failure modes: zombie tasks, hanging locks, and split-brain dual-generation. The 90-minute safety ceiling accommodates long-tail video render times while establishing an absolute deterministic upper boundary for automated task reclamation by R02 Reconciliation Workers. Monotonic attempt indexing guarantees clear auditability across retries.
capability_impact: Directly reinforces CAP-01 (Canonical Core State) and CAP-12 (Autonomous Error Recovery and Lease Management).
residual_risk: Clock skew between distributed worker nodes and PostgreSQL server affecting lease expiry calculations. Mitigated by using database-side timestamps (`NOW()`) for all lease evaluations and heartbeat expirations.
